scope: Complete standalone source Weights public operation surface through owned native IMSWeights; no standalone IMSAlphabet or decomposer completeness claim.

source_literals.coverage: Every distinct active class-test literal; copy/assignment/access aliases share native cases.

source_quirks: Exactly two coprime weights return true from divideByGCD; >=3 coprime return false.
NaN zero-mass rounding-error terms are ignored by literal comparisons; opposite-sign overflowing errors do not affect a finite requested bound.
Signed finite masses/precision whose rounded value is unsigned-representable remain valid.
Parent-mass sum and mass/weight swap preserve stored ordering.
native_corrections: Default precision is None rather than uninitialized.
u64 is fixed across platforms; source unsigned-long width varies.
Checked float-to-u64 conversion, index errors, all-zero GCD rejection and finite returned numeric values.
Precision/GCD updates are atomic; ordinary Clone maps source owned copy.
Fallible complete text generation replaces ostream insertion/flush behavior.

independent_tests.description: For quarter masses n/4 and positive integer precision p, exact integer oracle (n+2p)/(4p), n=0..399,p=1..7; other tests cover source-order binary64 sums, adjacent half/full-u64 boundaries, signed/zero inputs and resources.

validation: Eight integration tests plus one private cumulative-work atomicity test pass Rust1.98 all-features and Rust1.85 no-default, locked/offline -j2; strict focused Clippy passes both profiles. No C++ build or runtime parity claim.
review: Independent source-only review by source_analysis confirmed literal rounding, signed/zero/empty behavior, full-u64 bounds, pair-coprime return quirk and atomic GCD preflight; no implementation finding.
